commands.command:
cat > /root/certrotate/templates/renew-selfsigned-cert.sh.j2 <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

CERT_DIR="/etc/nginx/ssl"
LIVE_CERT="$CERT_DIR/live/cert.pem"
LIVE_KEY="$CERT_DIR/live/key.pem"
ARCHIVE_DIR="$CERT_DIR/archive"
THRESHOLD_SECONDS={{ cert_renew_threshold_seconds }}
VALID_DAYS={{ cert_valid_days }}
CN="{{ cert_common_name }}"
SAN="subjectAltName=DNS:{{ cert_common_name }},IP:{{ node_ip }}"

FORCE=0
if [ "${1:-}" = "--force" ]; then
  FORCE=1
fi

need_renew=1
if [ "$FORCE" -eq 0 ] && [ -f "$LIVE_CERT" ]; then
  if openssl x509 -in "$LIVE_CERT" -checkend "$THRESHOLD_SECONDS" -noout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    need_renew=0
  fi
fi

if [ "$need_renew" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Certificate still valid beyond renewal threshold, nothing to do."
  exit 0
fi

mkdir -p "$ARCHIVE_DIR"
TS="$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
NEW_KEY="$ARCHIVE_DIR/key-$TS.pem"
NEW_CERT="$ARCHIVE_DIR/cert-$TS.pem"

openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 \
  -keyout "$NEW_KEY" -out "$NEW_CERT" \
  -days "$VALID_DAYS" \
  -subj "/CN=$CN" \
  -addext "$SAN"

chmod 600 "$NEW_KEY"
chmod 644 "$NEW_CERT"

ln -sf "$NEW_CERT" "$LIVE_CERT.tmp"
mv -T "$LIVE_CERT.tmp" "$LIVE_CERT"
ln -sf "$NEW_KEY" "$LIVE_KEY.tmp"
mv -T "$LIVE_KEY.tmp" "$LIVE_KEY"

nginx -t
systemctl reload nginx

echo "Renewed certificate: $NEW_CERT"
ANTRIEB_EOF
echo WROTE1

cat > /root/certrotate/playbook.yml <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
---
- name: HTTPS on 8443 with auto-renewing, hot-reloaded self-signed certificate
  hosts: web
  become: yes
  vars:
    https_port: 8443
    cert_common_name: node1.cluster.local
    cert_valid_days: 90
    cert_renew_threshold_seconds: 2592000   # renew when < 30 days remain
    cert_renew_check_interval: "1h"

  tasks:
    - name: Install nginx and openssl
      apt:
        name:
          - nginx
          - openssl
        state: present
        update_cache: yes

    - name: Create certificate directories
      file:
        path: "{{ item }}"
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0750"
      loop:
        - /etc/nginx/ssl
        - /etc/nginx/ssl/live
        - /etc/nginx/ssl/archive

    - name: Install certificate renewal script
      template:
        src: renew-selfsigned-cert.sh.j2
        dest: /usr/local/sbin/renew-selfsigned-cert.sh
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0750"

    - name: Generate initial certificate if missing
      command: /usr/local/sbin/renew-selfsigned-cert.sh
      args:
        creates: /etc/nginx/ssl/live/cert.pem

    - name: Install nginx site config for cert-rotation HTTPS vhost
      template:
        src: nginx-cert-rotation.conf.j2
        dest: /etc/nginx/sites-available/cert-rotation.conf
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      register: nginx_site_conf

    - name: Enable cert-rotation site
      file:
        src: /etc/nginx/sites-available/cert-rotation.conf
        dest: /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/cert-rotation.conf
        state: link
      register: nginx_site_enabled

    - name: Validate nginx configuration
      command: nginx -t
      changed_when: false

    - name: Ensure nginx is enabled and started
      systemd:
        name: nginx
        enabled: yes
        state: started

    - name: Reload nginx if site config changed
      systemd:
        name: nginx
        state: reloaded
      when: nginx_site_conf.changed or nginx_site_enabled.changed

    - name: Install cert-renew systemd service
      template:
        src: cert-renew.service.j2
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/cert-renew.service
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      register: cert_renew_service

    - name: Install cert-renew systemd timer
      template:
        src: cert-renew.timer.j2
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/cert-renew.timer
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: "0644"
      register: cert_renew_timer

    - name: Reload systemd units
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: yes
      when: cert_renew_service.changed or cert_renew_timer.changed

    - name: Enable and start cert-renew timer
      systemd:
        name: cert-renew.timer
        enabled: yes
        state: started
ANTRIEB_EOF

commands.command:
cat > /root/certrotate/templates/renew-selfsigned-cert.sh.j2 <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

CERT_DIR="/etc/nginx/ssl"
LIVE_CERT="$CERT_DIR/live/cert.pem"
LIVE_KEY="$CERT_DIR/live/key.pem"
ARCHIVE_DIR="$CERT_DIR/archive"
THRESHOLD_SECONDS={{ cert_renew_threshold_seconds }}
VALID_DAYS={{ cert_valid_days }}
CN="{{ cert_common_name }}"
NODE_IP="{{ node_ip }}"

FORCE=0
if [ "${1:-}" = "--force" ]; then
  FORCE=1
fi

need_renew=1
if [ "$FORCE" -eq 0 ] && [ -f "$LIVE_CERT" ]; then
  if openssl x509 -in "$LIVE_CERT" -checkend "$THRESHOLD_SECONDS" -noout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    need_renew=0
  fi
fi

if [ "$need_renew" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Certificate still valid beyond renewal threshold, nothing to do."
  exit 0
fi

mkdir -p "$ARCHIVE_DIR"
TS="$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
NEW_KEY="$ARCHIVE_DIR/key-$TS.pem"
NEW_CERT="$ARCHIVE_DIR/cert-$TS.pem"
CNF="$(mktemp)"

cat > "$CNF" <<CNFEOF
[req]
distinguished_name = req_distinguished_name
x509_extensions = v3_req
prompt = no

[req_distinguished_name]
CN = $CN

[v3_req]
subjectAltName = @alt_names

[alt_names]
DNS.1 = $CN
IP.1 = $NODE_IP
CNFEOF

openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 \
  -keyout "$NEW_KEY" -out "$NEW_CERT" \
  -days "$VALID_DAYS" \
  -config "$CNF"

rm -f "$CNF"

chmod 600 "$NEW_KEY"
chmod 644 "$NEW_CERT"

ln -sf "$NEW_CERT" "$LIVE_CERT.tmp"
mv -T "$LIVE_CERT.tmp" "$LIVE_CERT"
ln -sf "$NEW_KEY" "$LIVE_KEY.tmp"
mv -T "$LIVE_KEY.tmp" "$LIVE_KEY"

nginx -t
systemctl reload nginx

echo "Renewed certificate: $NEW_CERT"
ANTRIEB_EOF
echo REWROTE
commands.stdout: REWROTE
